name: Fernandina Beach
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fernandina Beach, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas on Amelia Island: Dickens on Centre, the Lighted Christmas Parade, Santa's tree lighting, Tidings and Twinkle and Storybook Tea.
lede: Fernandina Beach does Christmas in its historic downtown and on the waterfront, with a Victorian market, a lighted parade, Santa's pickup truck and resort tree lightings on Amelia Island.
celebrates: Amelia Island's tourism site says the holidays run from the night before Thanksgiving to New Year's Eve. In Fernandina Beach the city lights its tree at Amelia River Waterfront Park, the merchants light historic downtown with thousands of white lights from November into January, and America's Youth leads a lighted parade. Dickens on Centre turns downtown into an English village for a December weekend, with Tiny Tim's Kids Zone and visits with St. Nick. The Ritz-Carlton and Omni resorts add their own tree lightings and Santa events, and the Ritz-Carlton tree lighting features Santa's arrival by Christmas train.
lastyear: Dickens on Centre calls its 2026 weekend the 12th annual festival, so last year's market in December 2025 was the 11th. Fernandina Beach Main Street says this year's Tidings and Twinkle will not include an illuminated procession or drone show, and that organizers hope to bring the procession back once the city finishes the riverfront walk. The tourism site also bills Tidings and Twinkle as a new holiday tradition at Amelia River Waterfront Park, so families have a new community evening on the calendar.
facts: Dickens on Centre is inspired by Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol and takes over downtown Fernandina Beach each December. The Amelia Island tourism site says the Ritz-Carlton tree is 40 feet tall. The downtown holiday lighting stays up from November into January 2027, long after the parades end. Fernandina Beach's annual New Year's Eve Shrimp Drop, listed on the tourism page, drops the shrimp at 7 pm and follows it with fireworks over the Fernandina Harbor Marina.
trains: Amelia Island has no train museum of its own, but trains still turn up at Christmas. The Amelia Island tourism page for the Ritz-Carlton tree lighting says Santa arrives by Christmas train. A City of Jacksonville events listing quoting the Omni Amelia Island resort mentions train rides at its Holiday Lights Celebration, though the resort's own tourism page does not, so confirm before you go. For a real railroad museum, see our Jacksonville terminal page.
train_links: The closest train museum page on our site, in Jacksonville.
traditions: Historic downtown Fernandina Beach is lit with thousands of twinkling white lights from November into January.
America's Youth organizes a parade of bands, dancers and lighted floats.
A free Victorian market with Tiny Tim's Kids Zone, St. Nick and costumed characters.
At the city's tree lighting Santa arrives in a red vintage Ford pickup truck.
The Omni and the Ritz-Carlton each hold a tree lighting with Santa.
A family friendly New Year's Eve shrimp drop with fireworks over the harbor.
kidfact: Santa arrives at Fernandina Beach's tree lighting in a red vintage Ford pickup truck, and the Ritz-Carlton says he arrives at its tree lighting by Christmas train.
faq: How do Fernandina Beach families celebrate Christmas?

They mix downtown events and resort events: the city tree lighting at the waterfront, a lighted parade on Centre Street, the Dickens on Centre market and tree lightings at the Omni and the Ritz-Carlton. The Amelia Island tourism site says the season runs from the night before Thanksgiving to New Year's Eve.
Where does Santa show up in Fernandina Beach?

The city's tree lighting has Santa arrive in a red vintage Ford pickup truck. The Omni lists photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, Dickens on Centre has visits with St. Nick, and the Ritz-Carlton holds Santa's Storybook Tea.
Is there a Christmas parade in Fernandina Beach?
Yes. America's Youth organizes the Lighted Christmas Parade in downtown Fernandina Beach, with bands, dancers and lighted floats, free to the public.
Where do we park for downtown events?
The Dickens on Centre page says downtown parking is very limited and offers complimentary parking and free trolleys at Central Park on 11th Street.
Is there anything for adults only?
Dickens After Dark is a 21 and over masquerade, and the Run Like the Dickens fun run is on the beach, so families may prefer the Kids Zone and market.
